purpose: Per product type: the jobs such a product cannot ship without, and what a reviewer asks of it. Never how it looks. The brief can drop or add any of them.

types.name: Point of sale

flows.job: Add items to a sale and see the running total
Change or remove a line before paying
Take payment and reach a receipt and an empty sale

questions: Can a whole sale be finished without leaving the main screen?
After a mistaken tap, how many actions bring the sale back to right?
What does the screen show between two customers?

types.name: Booking or reservation

flows.job: See what is free for a chosen day
Reserve a slot and get a confirmation that repeats what, when and where
Cancel or move an existing booking

questions: Is a taken slot told apart from a free one before it is chosen?
Does the confirmation repeat the date, the time and the name?
What does the person see when the details are incomplete or the slot is gone?

types.name: Admin or record management

flows.job: Find one record by search or filter
Add a record and see it in the list
Change a record and see the change in the list
Remove a record, with a confirmation or a way back

questions: After a save, is the result visible without a reload?
Does a rejected save keep what was typed and say which field is wrong?
What does the list show when it is empty and when nothing matches?

types.name: Analytics dashboard

flows.job: Read the headline figure for the default period
Change the period or segment and see every figure follow
Go from a figure to the rows behind it

questions: Does every figure state its unit and its period?
What is shown for a period with no data?
Which figure should be read first, and is it?

types.name: Storefront

flows.job: Find a product by category or search
Add to the cart, change a quantity and see the total follow
Enter details and reach an order confirmation

questions: Is the full price known before the last step?
Does the cart survive a reload?
What does an unavailable product look like, and can it be ordered?

types.name: Content or editorial site

flows.job: Reach an article from the front page
Go on from the end of an article to another one, or subscribe

questions: On a phone, do the title and the start of the text fit the first screen?
Is there a next step at the end of an article?

types.name: Sign-up or onboarding

flows.job: Create an account with valid details and land inside
Submit wrong or missing details and be told what to fix, with typed values kept

questions: How many fields come before the first thing of value?
Is every error next to its field, in words, and gone once fixed?
Can the person leave and come back without starting over?

types.name: Chat or support

flows.job: Send a message and see it in the thread
Open an earlier conversation

questions: What is shown while a reply is pending, and when sending fails?
Does the newest message stay in view?

types.name: Documentation

flows.job: Reach a page by search or navigation
Copy a code sample
Go to the next or the previous page

questions: Does the navigation show where the reader is?
Can a sample be copied in one action, with feedback?

types.name: Landing page

flows.job: Take the primary action from the first screen and see what happens next
Get from the first screen to the price or the details

questions: Is there exactly one primary action, and what happens after it is taken?
Would the first screen still say what this is with the image removed?
